component.title: AutoAnimateLayout
component.purpose: Animate keyed displacement and resizing through layout difference without inventing motion on layout properties.

states.description: A keyed layout boundary is ready to animate insertion and reordering.

claims.statement: The boundary snapshots keyed rectangles and animates only transform differences after insertion, removal, reorder, or resize.
The shared reduced-motion hook disables layout animation while preserving the resulting geometry.
Rows move as a consequence of the change that caused their displacement rather than independently drifting.
